assessment.basis: The recorded parameter reconstruction did not meet the audit's agreement criterion; the parameter comparisons retain the actual reconstructed values.

scientific_validation.note: Independently checked against the cited primary publication and official deposit; bibliographic validation does not imply fit reproducibility. The EOS is retained for provenance but is not recommended for quantitative use because table and figure-marker refits fail to reproduce the published coefficients.

primary_source_check.finding: The source defines a BM3 reference plus Mie-Gruneisen-Debye thermal pressure and says that all 65 deposited P-V-T rows determine K0 and K0'. The deposit's row 32 values are retained verbatim but flagged as an isolated source-data/refinement anomaly. An independent fit of the 47 plotted Figure 3a marker centers also fails badly, and Equation 1 is malformed as printed; the record is retained for provenance but is not recommended for quantitative use.

primary_data_check.finding: All 65 goethite (alpha-FeOOH) P-T lattice-parameter and unit-cell-volume observations published in depository Table 1. Depository row 32 itself reports the isolated 100 degC, 6.66 GPa values a = 4.159 A and V = 122.80 A^3; these are retained verbatim and flagged as a likely source-table or refinement anomaly rather than silently corrected.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Equation 1 and goethite EOS discussion, manuscript pages 6-7; Goethite thermodynamic parameters, Table 1 on manuscript page 15; MSA depository item AM-08-056, Table 1.
